source.dem_datum_and_projection: Read TIFF CRS/transform/nodata from raster metadata; do not invent vertical datum. AGL proxy only conditional on altitude source comparability.

spatial_correction.native_dem_coverage: Rasterio sample geospatial DEM elevation at every first-selected 5-minute native GPS fix in original 28 candidate birds, NOT at only height available fixes.
spatial_correction.fixed_coverage_gate: At least 0.80 of original candidate bird 5-minute fixes are inside DEM extent with finite unmasked elevation (independent of native GPS and barometric altitude). Otherwise report terrain unavailable; don't choose another raster or geographical filter after seeing heights.
spatial_correction.inclusion: All DEM valid native same-GPS-fix events, both sensor heights finite and within [-500,7000] m native ranges; do not replace earliest missing height with later fix.
spatial_correction.sensor_height: GPS MSL and barometric native height individually minus same raster elevation at each original GPS fix; retain native sensor-specific centering separately within every UTC bird-day.
spatial_correction.AGL_reasoning: Terrain subtraction removes large within-50km/5km topographic height differences but does not fully remove device error/DEM vertical datum mismatch/flight behavior changes.
spatial_correction.secondary_dem_coverage: Report per-bird and per-year geographic availability, not outcome-based exclusions.
spatial_correction.source_quality: Keep original required >=80% of the DEM-included source native GPS fixes dual-height finite. Every scored UTC day has >=50 matched 5minute fixes, else no evaluation.

mathematical_test.same_kernel: Use exact existing MEDGULL D1-balanced source day/bird equal self vs other bird 10-bin profile scorer from original dual sensor project.
mathematical_test.same_model: Hold out whole bird-days; same individual and same 5km grid versus other bird other date. Jeffreys 0.5 pseudocount/height bin, own other day support >=10 fixes and other-bird other date >=10.
mathematical_test.bird_day_centering: Per-sensor median AGL proxy among jointly complete DEM-covered first-selected 5min source GPS fixes that day; offline distribution-shape prediction.
mathematical_test.source_id: 28 original biological source roster from preheight frozen audit; no posthoc bird re-selection.
mathematical_test.null: 999 whole-bird-day source labels permuted within exact UTC date as original sensor pipeline; no fix-level shuffling; 950/999 valid minimum.
mathematical_test.multiple_testing: Holm across two GPS_AGL and BARO_AGL fixed sensor outcomes including unavailable p=1.
mathematical_test.positive_claim: Both GPS_AGL and BARO_AGL show positive null-adjusted identity score and Holm p<0.05, with DEM coverage gate and at least 10 birds; otherwise terrain-robust concordance unavailable/not supported.
mathematical_test.per_bird_comparison: Also report overlap/correlation with original 27 source bird gain estimates descriptively, but any significant new effect cannot be claimed independent validation because original heights have already been seen.

limitations: DEM is included in the original data archive and may be the same terrain source previously used to define home range/animal routing; using it is a postoutcome sensitivity check, not intervention.
GPS native height 'height-above-msl', barometric height could be calibrated from GPS or ambient weather, so sensor outcome agreement does NOT demonstrate independent physical sensors.
Subtracting a raster whose vertical datum does not exactly match each source height produces a DEM-referenced offset, not validated geodetic height-above-ground.
Grid-matched 5km altitude residual still includes within-cell microhabitat, flight state, diurnal/weather and tag-specific measurement errors.
Source 29 real birds includes a physical GPS calibration/test animal-label quarantined; original 28 eligible biological 5km bird IDs unchanged.
Tag serial 182208 occurs under two different bird IDs in full archive, but only one original eligible 28 belongs to the shared tag; pair-bird overlap needs explicit caveat.
success_or_failure: Do not change years, 5km, 10-bin edges, original 28 birds, 50 fix/day or DEM coverage threshold if unsupported. Keep original 27-bird native-height positive result unchanged.
